title: 第一百三十三章 一刀破阵第一百三十二章 半步圣器
content_zh:
第一百三十三章一刀破阵
斩断神魂联系后，他身形化作一道流光急速后退，瞬息便落至六十六位神仆合力凝聚而成的巨人虚影眉心处。
索科神皇将自身神力尽数外放，顺着阵纹脉络融入大阵，身躯则化作大阵神力汇聚、运转的核心节点。
随着核心结点的成型，大阵仿若有了阵灵。巨人虚影内分布的六十七处力量节点，化作六十七张饕餮巨口，开始疯狂吞噬天地间的灵气。四周灵气迅速汇聚而来，仅用了不到一刻钟的时间，方圆千里的天地灵气被汲取殆尽，此地成了灵气真空地带。
在海量灵气的灌注之下，巨人虚影愈发凝实，威压节节攀升，直至玉清境初期方才停止。
另一边，金丝蛛横渡虚空，来到秦枫身侧，朝着他低下头，自额头正中裂开一道缝隙，其内是一个三丈方圆的空间。空间正中悬浮着一颗直径三尺大小的金色圆球，球体上密密麻麻的符文有节律的循环流转，正是金丝蛛的控制核心。
雪林君以自身元婴祭炼而成的器灵，正静静立于金球一侧，十指掐动法诀，撤去自身对控制核心的掌控。
做完这些，器灵抬眼看向秦枫，眼中一片释然。
秦枫会意，没有犹豫，当即催动神识进入金色圆球，迅速在金色圆球内部烙印自己的神识印记，刹那间，操控金丝蛛的所有法门顺着神识涌入秦枫识海。
这时器灵突然打趣道：“师弟，从今往后我就是你的人了，你可不能亏待师兄我。”
突如其来的打趣令秦枫哭笑不得，他随即挥出一缕柔和的灵力，将金丝蛛额头的缝隙闭上。
紧接着腾空而起，稳稳落在金丝蛛脊背之上，掌心灵光一闪，魂塔浮现而出。秦枫指尖掐诀，塔中封存的海量精血与精纯灵气，源源不断的涌入金丝蛛体内。
在海量精血与灵气的滋养下，金丝蛛的身躯缓缓变大，直至百丈方才停止。
虚空之中，一只体形百丈的金色蜘蛛与一尊手握漆黑长刀的巨人虚影隔空对峙，两股强横的灵压在虚空对撞。
巨人虚影率先出手，厚重如山的漆黑巨刀凌空劈落，一道数十丈的幽黑刀芒撕裂长空，挟崩山裂石之威，径直斩向金丝蛛。
金丝蛛目露凶芒，狰狞巨口豁然张开，一道粗大的金丝破空刺出，带着割裂万物的锋锐，直击袭来的巨型刀芒。
“砰”的一声巨响，金芒与黑芒在虚空轰然碰撞。数十丈的幽黑刀芒顷刻崩裂溃散，那道粗大的金丝也受反震之力倒卷而回。两股恐怖巨力疯狂撕扯周围虚空，原本稳固的空间，被撕裂出密密麻麻的空间裂隙。
碰撞产生的狂暴罡风横扫千里，下方汝阴城撑起的防御光罩，在罡风下狂颤，灵光忽明忽暗，仿佛下一刻便会不堪重负而崩碎。城中修士人人心头紧绷，惶恐地望着虚空中惊天动地的斗法。
虚空中巨人虚影全身六十七处结点，同时挥刀，劈出六十七道一丈长的幽黑刀芒，斩向金丝蛛的不同要害。
金丝蛛巨口再度大张，数以万计的金丝喷涌而出，迅速分成一百三十四股，一半迎击六十七道袭来的幽黑刀芒，余下六十七股，直击各处结点上的神仆。

第一百三十三章一刀破阵
一连串密集炸裂之声接连响起，六十七道刀芒接连撞上金丝，尽数破碎。
而大阵结点上的索科神皇与六十六名神仆，同时受到数千金丝的攻击，其身前灵光闪动，一面面灵盾挡在他们身前。可金丝却轻易洞穿灵盾，随后轻轻一绞，灵盾应声碎裂。金丝却攻势不减，锋芒直刺阵中神族修士。
索科神皇与六十六名神仆面色一变，连忙挥动手中黑刀，劈斩迎面刺来的金丝，竭力阻拦金丝近身。
可谁也没有料到，就在众人缠斗之际，一道百丈刀影凭空出现在巨人虚影背后，自其右肩斜劈而下。刀影所过之处，大阵结点上的神仆，根本来不及祭出法宝、催动护体灵光，便被刀芒斩成一团血雾。
刀势一往无前，自巨人虚影左腰斜斩而出，大阵被硬生生劈裂。这一记突袭之下，十一名神仆当场殒命，漫天血沫混着溃散的阵法灵光，自高空洒落。
随着数十处结点神仆的陨落，大阵再难维系运转，索科神皇与一众神仆依托大阵加持的磅礴修为陡然跌落，周身气息急速跌落。
而在阵法被破、修为减弱的一瞬，又有二十几位神仆，因防御不及被数千金丝刺穿身躯，体内的精血与神魂也尽数被金丝吞噬。
见此情形，索科神皇尽全力挥刀，斩断攻击而来的金丝，同时施展虚空挪移术，从金丝的攻击下脱身。随即对着身后虚空的一道身影怒吼道：“秦笑天！你身为仙土老祖，却藏头露尾暗中偷袭，就不怕此事传开，沦为整个修真界的笑谈？”
秦笑天手持断天刀踏空而立，目光冷漠的注视着索科神皇，冷冷的开口道：“索科亚多，你无端领兵闯入仙土，倚仗修为便以大欺小、围猎后辈，究竟是谁给你的底气？一套残缺的半吊子刀阵，便让你目空一切，看不清形势。”
惨叫声再度响起，又有数名来不及后撤的神仆被金丝穿体而亡。侥幸躲过金丝绞杀的残存神仆连忙快速聚拢，将索科神皇护在中间。
另一侧的秦枫见自家老祖赶到，心中安定了不少。不然仅凭一己之力抗衡六十七名元婴修士布下的杀阵，纵有半步圣器金丝蛛，他也没有战胜的底气。
索科神皇面色阴沉，沉声道：“秦笑天，你门下弟子杀我神域神将，今日你必须给我神域一个交代！”
老祖朗声道：“索科亚多，你未经仙土许可，私自领军进犯仙土，还屠戮仙土雪氏全族，这笔帐是该好好清算。”
可话音未落，索科神皇掌心绽放出刺目金光，一枚破空符箓被他捏碎。其身侧虚空瞬间坍塌，形成一道丈许高的空间裂隙。他毫不迟疑的化作一道流光，掠入虚空裂隙之中。
余下的二十余名神仆，正欲紧随其后从虚空裂隙遁走。秦枫目光一冷，即刻催动金丝蛛，数万金丝如利箭般向一众神仆刺去。
没有了阵法加持，这些元婴境的神族修士，在半步圣器的攻击下，毫无反抗之力。瞬息之间，金丝便穿透肉身、绞碎元婴，二十余名神仆连惨叫都来不及，便以尽数殒命，精血、神魂被金丝尽数吞噬，化作了滋养金丝蛛的精纯养料。

Chapter 133 Breaking the Formation with One Sword
After cutting off the connection between his soul and his soul, his body turned into a stream of light and quickly retreated, and in an instant he landed between the eyebrows of the giant shadow formed by the combined efforts of sixty-six divine servants.
God Emperor Soko unleashed all his divine power and merged into the formation along the veins of the formation. His body became the core node for the gathering and operation of the formation's divine power.
As the core nodes took shape, the formation seemed to have an formation spirit. The sixty-seven power nodes distributed in the giant's shadow turned into sixty-seven giant gluttonous mouths, which began to crazily devour the spiritual energy between heaven and earth. The surrounding spiritual energy gathered quickly, and in less than a quarter of an hour, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth within a thousand miles radius was exhausted, and this place became a spiritual energy vacuum zone.
Under the infusion of massive spiritual energy, the giant's shadow became more and more solid, and the pressure gradually increased, and it did not stop until the early stage of Yuqing Realm.
On the other side, the Golden Silk Spider crossed the void, came to Qin Feng's side, lowered its head towards him, and opened a gap in the middle of its forehead, inside which was a space of three feet in diameter. There is a golden ball with a diameter of three feet suspended in the middle of the space. The densely packed runes on the ball circulate rhythmically, which is the control core of the Golden Silk Spider.
The weapon spirit refined by Lord Xue Lin with his own Nascent Soul is standing quietly on the side of the golden ball, pinching the magic formula with his ten fingers to remove his control of the control core.
After doing this, Qi Ling raised his eyes and looked at Qin Feng, with relief in his eyes.
Qin Feng understood and without hesitation, he immediately urged his spiritual consciousness to enter the golden ball, and quickly imprinted his own spiritual mark inside the golden ball. In an instant, all the techniques for controlling the golden silk spider poured into Qin Feng's sea of ​​consciousness along with his spiritual consciousness.
At this time, Qi Ling suddenly joked: "Junior brother, from now on I am yours, you can't treat me badly."
The sudden joke made Qin Feng dumbfounded. He then waved a ray of gentle spiritual power to close the gap on the Golden Silk Spider's forehead.
Then it rose into the air and landed firmly on the back of the golden spider. With a flash of light from the palm of its hand, the soul tower emerged. Qin Feng made a secret with his fingertips, and the massive amount of blood essence and pure spiritual energy sealed in the tower poured into the Golden Silk Spider's body.
Nourished by the massive amount of essence, blood and spiritual energy, the Golden Silk Spider's body slowly grew in size, and did not stop until it reached a hundred feet.
In the void, a golden spider with a body of hundreds of feet faced off against the shadow of a giant holding a black sword in the air. The two powerful spiritual pressures collided in the void.
The giant shadow was the first to take action, and the dark giant sword as thick as a mountain fell in the air. A tens of feet of dark black sword light tore through the sky, carrying the power of collapsing mountains and cracking rocks, and slashed straight towards the golden spider.
The golden spider's eyes showed a fierce light, and its ferocious mouth suddenly opened. A thick golden thread pierced through the air, with the sharpness of cutting all things, and directly hit the incoming giant sword light.
There was a loud "bang" sound, and golden light and black light collided in the void. The tens of feet of dark black sword light instantly collapsed and dispersed, and the thick golden thread was also rolled back by the force of the shock. Two terrifying giant forces crazily tore through the surrounding void, and the originally stable space was torn into dense space cracks.
The violent wind generated by the collision swept across thousands of miles. The defensive light shield supported by Ruyin City below trembled wildly under the strong wind. The aura flickered on and off, as if it would be overwhelmed and collapse in the next moment. All the monks in the city were tense and looked at the earth-shattering fight in the void with fear.
The giant shadow in the void had sixty-seven nodes on its body. It swung its sword at the same time, striking out sixty-seven one-foot-long dark blade lights, slashing at different vital points of the golden silk spider.
The golden silk spider opened its huge mouth again, and tens of thousands of golden threads spurted out, quickly divided into one hundred and thirty-four strands, half of which met the sixty-seven incoming dark black sword lights, and the remaining sixty-seven strands directly hit the divine servants at various nodes.
Chapter 133 Breaking the Formation with One Sword
A series of dense explosions sounded one after another, and sixty-seven sword lights hit the golden wire one after another, all of them shattered.
The Emperor Soko and the sixty-six divine servants at the node of the formation were simultaneously attacked by thousands of golden threads.Attacking, a spiritual light flashed in front of them, and a spiritual shield blocked them in front of them. But the golden thread easily penetrated the spiritual shield, and then with a slight twist, the spiritual shield shattered. The golden thread's offensive continued unabated, and its sharp edge pierced the divine monks in the formation.
The expressions of God Emperor Soko and the sixty-six servants of God changed, and they quickly waved the black knives in their hands, slashing the golden threads that were coming towards them, trying their best to prevent the golden threads from getting closer.
But no one expected that while everyone was fighting, a shadow of a hundred feet of sword appeared out of thin air behind the giant's shadow and slashed down from his right shoulder. Wherever the sword shadow passed, the divine servants at the nodes of the formation had no time to sacrifice their magic weapons and activate their body-protecting auras, before they were cut into a ball of blood mist by the sword's light.
The sword moved forward fiercely, slashing diagonally from the left waist of the giant's shadow, and the formation was abruptly split apart. Under this sudden attack, the eleven divine servants died on the spot, and blood foam mixed with the disintegrating formation aura fell from high in the sky.
With the death of dozens of divine servants at the nodes, it was no longer possible for the formation to maintain its operation. The majestic cultivation of God Emperor Soko and a group of divine servants relying on the blessing of the formation suddenly fell, and the aura around them dropped rapidly.
At the moment when the formation was broken and their cultivation weakened, more than twenty servants of the gods were pierced by thousands of gold threads due to lack of defense, and all the essence, blood and soul in their bodies were swallowed up by the gold threads.
Seeing this situation, God Emperor Soko swung his sword with all his strength to cut off the attacking golden thread. At the same time, he used the void movement technique to escape from the golden thread's attack. Then he roared at a figure in the void behind him: "Qin Xiaotian! As an ancestor of the Immortal Earth, you hide your head and tail and attack secretly. Aren't you afraid that this matter will spread and become a joke in the entire cultivation world?"
Qin Xiaotian stood in the air with the Sky-Breaking Sword in his hand, staring at God Emperor Soko with cold eyes, and said coldly: "Soko Yado, you led troops into the immortal land for no reason, and relied on your cultivation to bully the small and hunt the younger ones. Who gave you the confidence? A incomplete and half-baked sword formation makes you arrogant and unable to see the situation clearly."
The screams rang out again, and several more servants of the gods who had no time to retreat were pierced by gold threads and died. The remaining servants of God who were lucky enough to escape the golden wire strangle quickly gathered together to protect God Emperor Soko in the middle.
Qin Feng on the other side felt a lot more at ease when he saw his ancestor arriving. Otherwise, if he could resist the killing array set up by sixty-seven Nascent Soul monks by himself, he would not have the confidence to defeat even the half-step holy weapon Golden Silk Spider.
God Emperor Suoko looked gloomy and said in a deep voice: "Qin Xiaotian, your disciples killed the generals of my God Realm. Today you must give an explanation to my God Realm!"
The ancestor said loudly: "Sokoado, you privately led an army to invade the Immortal Land without the permission of the Immortal Land, and also massacred the entire Xue clan of the Immortal Land. This debt should be settled properly."
But before he finished speaking, a dazzling golden light burst out from the palm of God Emperor Soko, and a sky-breaking talisman was crushed by him. The void beside him collapsed instantly, forming a space crack about ten feet high. He turned into a stream of light without hesitation and swept into the crack in the void.
The remaining twenty-odd servants of God were about to escape from the void rift following closely behind. Qin Feng's eyes turned cold, and he immediately activated the golden silk spider, and tens of thousands of golden threads stabbed at the servants of the gods like sharp arrows.
Without the blessing of the formation, these divine monks in the Nascent Soul Realm had no power to resist under the attack of the half-step holy weapon. In an instant, the golden thread penetrated the flesh and crushed the Nascent Soul. More than twenty servants of the gods died without even having time to scream. Their essence, blood, and soul were swallowed up by the golden thread, and turned into pure nutrients that nourished the golden spider.
